title: Polonnaruwa Ancient City Tour with Minneriya Elephant Safari
description: DescriptionBelow are the locations for your day trip1.Royal Palace Complex2.Gal Vihara3.sacred Quadrangle4.Minneriya National ParkBegin your adventure in Polonnaruwa, a UNESCO World Heritage Site celebrated for its rich history and archaeological marvels. As you step onto its hallowed ground, you'll be transported back in time to the days of ancient Sri Lankan kingdoms. Roam among the ancient ruins, intricately carved stone sculptures, and remarkably preserved monuments that bear witness to the island's glorious past.Our experienced guides will lead you through this open-air museum, regaling you with tales of kings and kingdoms. You'll visit the Royal Palace, where royalty once resided, the awe-inspiring Gal Vihara with its colossal Buddha statues, and the sacred Quadrangle, a spiritual center rich in history. Along the way, you'll gain a deep understanding of the art, architecture, and cultural heritage that define PolonnaruwaAfter immersing yourself in the historical wonders of Polonnaruwa, it's time for an exhilarating wildlife adventure. The Minneriya National Park, just a short drive away, promises an unforgettable Minneriya Elephant Safari. This park is renowned for its incredible gatherings of elephants, often called 'The Gathering,' where herds of these magnificent creatures come together to graze, socialize, and play.Your journey into the wild begins as you board a sturdy 4x4 safari jeep, accompanied by our experienced naturalists. They'll share their deep knowledge of the park's ecosystem and its inhabitants, ensuring you witness the awe-inspiring spectacle of Sri Lankan elephants in their natural habitat. As you watch these gentle giants up close, you'll gain a newfound appreciation for their beauty and grace.

title: Fom Dambulla: Sigiriya Rock & Ancient City of Polonnaruwa
description: DescriptionBelow are the locations for your day trip1.Royal Palace2.Nissankamulla Palace3.Gal Viharaya4.Thuparama stupa5.Lankathilaka stupa6.Vatadage7.Rankoth Vehera8.Parakramabahu Statue9.Sigiriya Rock Fortress,Begin your exciting day with a pick-up from your hotel, heading towards Sigiriya.Proceed to Polonnaruwa, another ancient city steeped in history. Embark on a guided 3.5-hour tour of Polonnaruwa Ancient City, a remarkable World Heritage Site from the 12th century. Marvel at the palaces, dagobas, and temples that exemplify the brilliance of Sri Lankan historical craftsmanship. During the tour, visit key landmarks such as the Royal Palace, Nissankamulla Palace, Gal Viharaya, Thuparama stupa, Lankathilaka stupa, Vatadage, Rankoth Vehera, and Parakramabahu Statue, each holding captivating stories from the past.Climb and visit the majestic Sigiriya Rock Fortress, an ancient marvel built by King Kashyapa in the 5th century. Standing 660 feet tall, this Unesco World Heritage Site, also known as Lion's Rock or Sinhagiri, offers breathtaking views and a glimpse into Sri Lanka's rich history. Ascend the 1200 steps to reach the top and explore the well-preserved ruins of the ancient palace and water gardens. The impressive lion carving at the entrance and the innovative irrigational and archaeological technologies still in use make Sigiriya a wonder of the world. The well-designed ramparts and moats surrounding the rock are a testament to its powerful defense.As the tour concludes, return to your hotel, reflecting on the awe-inspiring historical wonders and cultural heritage experienced in Sigiriya and Polonnaruwa.

title: From Sigiriya, ANURADHAPURA UNESCO CITY day tour and safari
description: DescriptionBelow are the locations for your day trip1.Sacred Bodhi Tree2.Ruwanwelisaya Stupa3.The Royal Palace and Abhayagiri Monastery4.Isurumuniya Vihara5.Twin Ponds6.Moonstone7.WessagiriyaExplore Anuradhapura's ancient marvels on a day tour from Sigiriya. We invite you to journey through one of Sri Lanka’s most historically rich cities.Begin with a hotel pickup in Sigiriya, traveling comfortably in an air-conditioned vehicle through lush landscapes to Anuradhapura.Discover this UNESCO World Heritage Site, renowned for its well-preserved ruins, stupas, and intricate carvings. Visit the Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi, a sacred fig tree revered in Buddhism for over 2,000 years. Marvel at the Ruwanwelisaya Stupa, a towering monument symbolizing ancient Sri Lankan engineering prowessExplore remnants of the Royal Palace and Abhayagiri Monastery, offering insights into ancient Sri Lankan life. Admire rock carvings at Isurumuniya Vihara, showcasing the artistic talents of ancient craftsmen. Visit the Twin Ponds, an engineering marvel providing a serene setting for reflection and photography.Experience the ancient Moonstone, a carved stone slab representing the cycle of life. Explore Wessagiriya, an ancient monastic complex nestled amidst rocky outcrops. Enjoy traditional Sri Lankan cuisine at a local restaurant.(not included) Enriched by profound experiences, return to Sigiriya with a deeper understanding of Sri Lanka’s history and culture.

Here, Sir Thomas Lipton used to survey his burgeoning empire, and today it's said you can see across emerald hills and tea estates to no fewer than seven different provinces.

title: Ella: Little Adam's Peak and Nine Arch Bridge Half-Day Tour
description: DescriptionBelow are the locations for your day trip1.Little Adam's Peak2.Nine Arch BridgeDiscover the beauty of Ella on this half day tour. Your personal guide will take you to the famous Nine Arch Bridge before you witness the stunning views of Ella's natural beauty from Little Adam's Peak.Stroll along the unique attraction of the Nine Arch Bridge railway, spanning 91 meters alongside dense jungle and agricultural settings. Stop for photos of the nine arches. With the forest booming behind the railway and the tea leaves cultivated below from the plantations, the beautiful bridge stands out from the epic scenery as a picturesque masterpiece. The bridge is built entirely from rocks and bricks, without metal or steel.Next, your guide will take you on a small hike to Little Adam's Peak to see the greenery of Ella, surrounded by tea fields and rural beauty. The moderate trail winds through tea plantations, where you may see locals working and picking the tea leaves. The trail offers multiple platforms, rocks and viewpoints perfect for photos, with the view getting more spectacular as you walk along the ridge to the summit. Take in the unbelievable views across the mountain highlands of Sri Lanka, before you walk back down to finish the tour.Transfers are included to bring you to and from your hotel for the half day tour via tuk tuk. Water is provided for you, to keep you hydrated throughout the walk. Chose from a morning or afternoon start time.

description: DescriptionBelow are the locations for your day trip1.Yala National ParkYour day will begin with pick-up at Galle and proceed to Yala national park. Yala National Park, located on the southeastern coast of Sri Lanka, is the country's most famous and diverse wildlife sanctuary. Known for its remarkable leopard population, it offers thrilling opportunities to spot these elusive cats. The park's picturesque landscapes encompass lush forests, arid plains, and a stunning coastline, making it a haven for wildlife enthusiasts and nature lovers. Visitors can embark on jeep safaris guided by experts, witnessing not only leopards but also elephants, birds, and other fascinating creatures in their natural habitat. With its rich biodiversity and conservation efforts, Yala National Park promises an unforgettable wildlife adventure in a pristine natural environment. You can either return to your accommodation at Galle.

title: Colombo & Negombo To Galle | Hikkaduwa | Mirissa Day Tour
description: DescriptionBelow are the locations for your day trip1.Galle Fort2.Maadu lake3.Turtle conservation project in Kosgoda4.Unawatuna Beach5.Stilt FishermanThe itinerary begins with a visit to Galle Fort, where guests can walk along the historic walls and take memorable photos with guidance from their tour guide. The next stop is the Madu Ganga Biodiversity Area in Balapitiya, offering an exciting mangrove boat safari. During this trip, visitors can enjoy a fish foot massage and observe various wildlife such as crocodiles, large lizards, and numerous bird species.The tour continues to the Kosgoda Sea Turtle Conservation Project, where participants can learn about and witness the conservation efforts for sea turtles. Here, the team cares for the eggs and young turtles for up to five years before releasing them back into the wild. Afterward, lunch is served at a highly-rated beachside restaurant on Unawatuna Beach, where visitors can also enjoy a relaxing walk along the coast.Following lunch, the tour heads back to Galle Fort to visit the iconic lighthouse and take more photographs. Another unique experience is offered at Koggala, where guests can try stilt fishing, a traditional method of fishing in Sri Lanka. The journey then proceeds to the Japanese Peace Pagoda in Rumassala, and concludes with a brief stop at the Sea Turtle Farm in Galle Mahamodara, further highlighting the region's efforts in sea turtle conservation.

title: From Negombo: Southern Coast Highlights Private Day Tour
description: DescriptionBelow are the locations for your day trip1.Handunugoda Tea Factory2.Fishing at Ahangama3.Colonial city of Galle4.Kosgoda Turtle HatcheryStart your day tour with pickup from your hotel in Negombo at 6:30 AM. The first stop on your tour itinerary will be the Handunugoda Tea Factory which you will reach at approximately 9:30 AM. The Handunugoda Tea Factory reawakened the ancient Chinese tradition of creating Virgin White Tea, which is untouched by human hands during the manufacturing process. During the one-and-a-half-hour tour of the factory, see how this mysterious process takes place to create one of the top luxury teas in the world.Travel next to Ahangama to meet the stilt fishermen, who are one of the most iconic figures of Sri Lanka. Learn how they practice this unique and intricate fishing technique from a local practitioner of this ancient tradition.At approximately 12:00 PM you will stop for a lunch at your own expense in a place of your choosing, before reaching Galle at 2:00 PM. This coastal city has withstood three foreign invasions; during which time, it grew from a bustling port which was the main stop for ships travelling east, to a fortified and yet beautiful city with many monuments which have withstood the ravages of time. See the Galle Fort which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the Galle Lighthouse, the National Maritime Museum, the picturesque cobblestoned streets, and many more colonial remnants.Leave Galle at 3:30 PM to visit the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, a journey that takes approximately 1 hour. Learn about the 5 types of sea turtles that visit Sri Lanka for nesting, and how the nests are protected. You will be able to see and touch baby turtles and view some of the fully-grown turtles that are treated for injuries and ailments. Return to your hotel by 8:30 PM to complete the excursion.

description: DescriptionBelow are the locations for your day trip1.Independence Square2.National Museum3.Gangarama Temple4.The Lotus Tower5.Old Parliment Building and Colombo Lighthouse6.Colombo Petta public marketThe Colombo one-day city tour offers a captivating glimpse into the vibrant capital of Sri Lanka, blending modernity with a rich historical and cultural tapestry. A bustling metropolis situated on the west coast of the island, Colombo is a fascinating mix of colonial charm, contemporary architecture, and lively local markets.Begin your day at Independence Square, a symbolic location that commemorates Sri Lanka's independence from British rule in 1948. The picturesque square features a monument and a surrounding park, providing a serene start to your exploration.Next, head to the National Museum of Colombo, where you can delve into the island's history. The museum houses a diverse collection, including artifacts from ancient kingdoms, traditional art, and exhibits on Sri Lanka's colonial past.Venture to Gangaramaya Temple, a prominent Buddhist temple that seamlessly integrates various architectural styles. The temple complex includes a museum, a library, and a sacred Bodhi tree, making it a spiritual and cultural hub.In the afternoon, immerse yourself in the vibrant chaos of Pettah Market. This bustling commercial area is a labyrinth of narrow streets filled with shops selling spices, textiles, jewelry, and an array of other goods. It's a sensory delight, and bargaining is a common practice.Explore the architectural beauty of the Old Parliament Building, a colonial-era structure with neoclassical influences. Adjacent to it stands the Colombo Lighthouse, offering a panoramic view of the city and the Indian Ocean.Lotus Tower is a prominent architectural landmark located in Colombo, the capital city of Sri Lanka. Also known as the Nelum Kuluna in Sinhala, the Lotus Tower stands as one of the tallest structures in South Asia and serves various purposes, including telecommunications, observation, and tourism.Embarking on a shopping tour in Colombo, the vibrant capital city of Sri Lanka, is an exciting and rewarding experience. Colombo, with its blend of modernity and tradition, offers a diverse range of shopping opportunities that cater to various tastes and preferences. Whether you're seeking traditional handicrafts, high-end fashion, or unique souvenirs, Colombo has it all.According to this part visit textile shop, hand craft shop, gem and jewelry

description: DescriptionBelow are the locations for your day trip1.Turtle Hatchery2.Madu Ganga3.Local Cinnamon Garden4.stilt fishermen in actionDiscover the Madu Ganga River on a boat safari from Colombo. See the mangrove forests and marshlands that surround the river. Stop at a cinnamon garden, and try some of the area’s famous cinnamon. Visit a local turtle hatchery and the Galle Fort.After being picked up at your hotel, hop onboard your Madu Ganga Magrove boat safari and explore the Madu River. See the mangrove forests and marshlands that surround the river. Stop at a cinnamon garden, and try some of the area’s famous cinnamon. The Madu Ganga River region is home to some of the best quality cinnamon in the world as well as a flourishing cinnamon industry.Afterward, marvel at the fishermen who stoically sit atop large branches planted in the middle of the water waiting for their catch. Continue to a local Turtle Hatchery, where your guide will introduce you to the many local varieties of turtles.End your tour with a visit to the Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This fort illustrates the unique interaction of European architecture and South Asian traditions from the 16th to the 19th centuries. After discovering the fort, you will be returned to your hotel in Colombo.

description: DescriptionBelow are the locations for your day trip1.Minneriya National Park2.Sigiriya Rock Fortress3.Dambulla Cave Temple4.HiriwadunnaExplore the Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress and Minneriya National Park on a day trip from Colombo. Visit the Hiriwadunna Village and enjoy a Sri Lankan buffet, take a jeep safari in Minneriya National Park, and visit the Dambulla Cave Temple.Start your day with a visit to the Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the 8th Wonder of the World. Climb to the top of the rock and admire the panoramic views of the surrounding areaNext, visit the Hiriwadunna Village and enjoy a Sri Lankan buffet. Take a village safari, starting with a bull cart ride, then go to the lake for a catamaran ride, and finally go to a village home. Enjoy a Sri Lankan rice and curry meal with a small cookery demonstration.After lunch, head to Minneriya National Park for a 4-hour jeep safari. See herds of elephants as they walk 35 km every day. During the season, visit the Hurulu Eco Park near Minneriya.On your way back to Colombo, stop at the historical Dambulla Cave Temple and Golden Temple.

title: From Colombo : Day Trip to Kandy | Pinnwala | Royal Gardens
description: DescriptionBelow are the locations for your day trip1.Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage2.Royal Botanical Gardens3.Temple of the Tooth in Kandy4.Kandy spice walk5.Tea factory tour6.Kandy View PointExperience the vibrant culture and natural beauty of Sri Lanka on this captivating tour from Colombo to Kandy. Your journey begins with a visit to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can observe and interact with orphaned elephants as they bathe and play in the river. This heartwarming experience offers a glimpse into the conservation efforts dedicated to protecting these magnificent creaturesContinue to the Temple of the Tooth in Kandy, a sacred Buddhist site that houses the relic of the tooth of the Buddha. Marvel at the intricate architecture and experience the spiritual atmosphere of this revered temple.Next, immerse yourself in the tranquility of the Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya. Explore the vast collection of plants, including orchids, palms, and medicinal plants, while enjoying the peaceful ambiance of this botanical paradise.Afterwards, embark on a spice walk in Kandy, where you'll learn about the spices that are integral to Sri Lankan cuisine. Engage your senses as you smell and taste a variety of spices, gaining insight into their flavors and uses.Conclude your tour with a visit to a tea factory, where you'll learn about the process of tea production from leaf to cup. Discover the art of tea making and sample some of the finest Ceylon teaFinally, make your way to Kandy View Point, where you'll be rewarded with panoramic views of the city and its picturesque surroundings. Capture the breathtaking scenery and create lasting memories of your journey through Sri Lanka.The tour will conclude with drop-off at the same location in Colombo where you were picked up.

title: Galle and Bentota Day-Tour From Colombo
description: DescriptionBelow are the locations for your day trip1.Madu Gaga2.Local Cinnamon Garden3.Turtle Sanctuary4.Stilt fishermen in action5.Galle FortAfter being picked up at your hotel, hop onboard your Madu Ganga Magrove boat safari and explore the Madu River. See the mangrove forests and marshlands that surround the river. Stop at a cinnamon garden, and try some of the area’s famous cinnamon. The Madu Ganga River region is home to some of the best quality cinnamon in the world as well as a flourishing cinnamon industry. Afterward, marvel at the fishermen who stoically sit atop large branches planted in the middle of the water waiting for their catch.Continue to a local Turtle Hatchery, where your guide will introduce you to the many local varieties of turtles. End your tour with a visit to the Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This fort illustrates the unique interaction of European architecture and South Asian traditions from the 16th to the 19th centuries. After discovering the fort, you will be returned to your hotel in Colombo
